lessons.trigger_condition: An exact collector number from One Piece, Naruto or an unattributed record could be scored as a candidate when Pokemon was explicitly selected; a score penalty was not a game isolation gate.
lessons.prevention_rule: When game is explicitly selected among Pokemon, One Piece and Naruto, candidates must have that exact game. Preserve unknown-game exploratory discovery, explicit card identity confirmation and edition/printing gates.
validation_required: Same collector number across all three core games cannot cross selected game boundary
Unknown-game rows never masquerade as selected game
Unknown-game exploratory match remains usable without claims of verified card value
Two cross-game OCR regression tests pass alongside existing OCR suite
Exact protected-main candidate SHA, static SHA256 and reviewed immutable successor contract required
Full Tablet GPT alignment, exhaustive SELFREFINE, integrity and CodeQL pass before merge
lessons.safety_boundary: No grading calibration, market price, certification, AI model, tablet-local user data or non-core TCG activation changed. No physical Lenovo validation claimed.
